content: # OverflowParticles ![Compact Powered by OneConfig](https://polyfrost.org/img/compact_vector.svg) ![Dev Workflow Status](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Polyfrost/OverflowParticles.svg?style=for-the-badge&color=1452cc&label=release) 專為 1.8.9 設計的高度精確且先進的粒子模組。 ## 功能 - 個別粒子設定 - 大小與數量倍率 - 可自訂顏色 - 淡出效果 ## 展示 ![settings-page.png](https://github.com/Polyfrost/OverflowParticles/raw/main/images/settings-page.png) ![settings.png](https://github.com/Polyfrost/OverflowParticles/raw/main/images/settings.png) ![particle.png](https://github.com/Polyfrost/OverflowParticles/raw/main/images/particle.png)
